provider_checks.name: DBLP public SPARQL service
provider_checks.status: A 64-cell title-only census completed on 2026-08-07. The exact query and 55 unique returned publications are preserved; 50 were absent from both prior comparison sets. DBLP is replacement evidence, not a publisher-native or Scopus-equivalent source.

interpretation: A missing exact DOI in the deterministic sample demonstrates a coverage gap but does not estimate recall for all software-engineering literature. A follow-up known-set audit found all 26 TSE candidates from the probe in SciX by exact DOI; that result does not estimate topic-search recall within TSE or establish IEEE Xplore coverage. The DBLP census exposed 50 title-matched publications absent from both the manuscript reference set and the OpenAlex probe, especially in conference streams, but lacks abstract and keyword search and is not equivalent to Scopus. Exact-DOI enrichment supported preliminary model triage. Source-hashed, page-level verification covers all 18 open-routed candidates plus 13 of the 16 records initially routed as closed; the other three have explicit access exceptions. The 34 retained candidates were discovered after the August 6 cutoff and were deferred to the next-edition queue because none identified a factual correction; no candidate was represented as an admission. ACM Digital Library, IEEE Xplore, and Scopus were not searched in this edition; their exact plans ship unexecuted as a disclosed limitation rather than an unmet release gate.
